tips.text: Train level 6 before you leave Deathknell.
Forever paladin: check your trainer for Undead paladin spells before you leave.
Forever: each creature can only be skinned once, so skin your own kills right away before someone else does.
Forever: every profession gets a camp object at skill 20. Push your professions to 20 early to unlock it.
Forever: crafting items to sell to vendors no longer pays (vendor prices were cut on 16 Oct). Craft for skill-ups, your own gear and other players.
Forever: healing potions are made with First Aid now, so keep your Linen Cloth for First Aid.
Forever: starter-zone Herbalism and Skinning trainers teach only the first rank. Train the next rank in your capital.
